title: Italian-Style Waffle Pancake Sandwich
description: A creative twist on traditional pancakes, topped with a rich Italian-inspired filling and wrapped in a crispy waffle.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cook the American pancake mix according to package instructions.
Meanwhile, toast the waffle in the same skillet until crispy.
In a small saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over low heat.
Add the caramel sauce to the melted butter and stir until smooth.
Once the pancakes are cooked, place one on a flat surface.
Spread a layer of whipped cream on top of the pancake.
Add a layer of fresh berries on top of the whipped cream.
Place the toasted waffle on top of the berries.
Drizzle the caramel sauce over the waffle.
Sprinkle powdered sugar on top of the waffle.
Fold the waffle in half to create a sandwich, pressing gently.
